source_inspiration.pathforge_fit_adaptation: Instead of generating selling product descriptions, this local offline artifact lets ecommerce sellers paste product features and claims, then inspect shelf-card readiness, unsupported absolute-claim warnings, tone badges, benefit/spec balance, and an exportable launch checklist.

steps.prompt_exact: I sell products online and want a tiny one-file browser tool I can open on my phone: paste a product name, features, and draft claims, then get shelf-card readiness scores, unsupported-claim warnings, tone badges, benefit/spec balance, and a copy/download launch checklist.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a self-contained HTML product copy/shelf-card tool with readiness scoring, tone badges, warnings, checklist generation, and manifest download, but used inline onclick and dynamic innerHTML rendering.
